name: exp_series_truncate
returns: tuple[int, int]  # (out_num, out_den) of S_N reduced to lowest terms
summary: Compute the exp Taylor-series partial sum S_N(p/q) = sum_{k=0..N} (p/q)^k / k! as an exact rational via Class N rational + Class J integer factorial chain composition. Returns (out_num, out_den) reduced to lowest terms. Anchors Spike #28 §10 chain-spec form + §11 asymptotic-calculus catalog scope.
